title: Checked WebAssembly capability API
objective: Validate browser workflow aliases against exact reviewed capability IDs, generate them into the public report, and expose a host-neutral capability query API for web and mobile shells

handoff.summary: Added a reviewed workflow-alias table tied exactly to the browser parity corpus, fail-closed manifest and report validation, 11 newly explicit analytic/elliptic/SagePack/algebraic capability records, and a deeply immutable host-neutral query API for website, mobile, and release shells.
risks: Shared analytic, elliptic, and algebraic records deliberately remain planned on this pre-receipt branch; integration must only mark them available when the production toolchain receipt contains their exact IDs.
The website/mobile staging closure must authenticate and copy wasm-capability-api.mjs beside the generated report before those shells replace their local report helpers.
next_steps: After the toolchain receipt lands, mark its eight aggregate shared/generated capabilities available and classify the 24 receipt-bound algebraic N-API operations as shared-core/available.
Stage architecture/wasm-capability-api.mjs with the authenticated public report and pass receipt capability IDs to createSagejsCapabilityAPI.
Install the checked API into the isolated evaluator before adding a Sage-language sagejs_capabilities wrapper; do not embed the 400+ KiB report in strict Python.
